title: AIreport VOL.6 | The Curation with Yein (정예인)
description:
🗃️The Archive │The Curation🗃️

An artist’s album or portfolio is the result of years of dedication, and without taking the time to fully dissect and absorb every detail, its true depth can be overlooked. To truly explore an artist’s life, inspirations, and behind-the-scenes stories, we bring you ‘The Curation’ and for today’s episode, we’re featuring the one and only, Yein of Lovelyz.

아티스트의 앨범이나 포트폴리오에는 수년간의 노력이 고스란히 담겨 있죠. 하지만 그 안의 이야기를 천천히 들여다보지 않으면, 작품이 가진 깊이를 놓치기 쉽습니다. 그래서 준비한 코너, ‘The Curation’. 오늘의 게스트는 정예인님입니다.
